conclusions.title: The Siku/Hu text says 東武公 in exactly the deposition/ox-cart frame. The unannotated current witness says 車武公 there but itself says 東武公 in the later Xuchang transfer. 公 is duke. This supplies an explicit alternate-primary basis for an English Duke of Dongwu proposal; no canonical Chinese emendation is made.
conclusions.rank: Hu’s explicit note identifies 保林 as an Eastern Palace female rank (東宫女官品秩); Forest Keeper is not the office in this maternal clause.
conclusions.name: Hu’s 虨甫斤翻 supports Bin, not Xian; all six occurrences in the current chapter refer to the named eldest son/grandson.
